title: Where's the Money
description: A young man from South Central Los Angeles must pledge a fraternity to recover a stash of stolen money.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E11 — The Unnatural
During another lonely Saturday night, Wanda, Keith and Jenny vow to go on dates with people without trying to pursue meaningful relationships; whoever cannot resist a second date must pay the others; unfortunately, all three meet great partners.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E10 — Twas the Knife Before Christmas
Wanda desperately wants to go to a fancy Christmas Eve party with Keith, but when Jenny is hospitalized with appendicitis, Wanda must take care of the kids; Still wanting to attend the bash, Wanda hurriedly gets her apartment ready for the holiday.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E03 — Roller Fitness With Tiffany Haddish
Kevin Hart joins good friend Tiffany Haddish at Moonlight Rollerway for a day of fitness rollerblading with LA Roller Girls.

title: Boiling Point
description: A Treasury agent (Wesley Snipes) and a mobster (Dennis Hopper) hunt each other according to their separate-but-equal deadlines for success.

title: Belly
description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere and Buns have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive; as adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery.

title: Small Town Crime
description: When alcoholic ex-cop Mike Kendall finds the body of a young woman, he becomes obsessed with redeeming himself by finding the killer. In the process, he puts himself and his family in danger while hanging out with an assortment of shady characters.

title: Held Up
description: Yuppie Alex (Jamie Foxx) stops for gas at a remote convenience store, gets dumped by his fiancée (Nia Long) and becomes a hostage during a robbery.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E17 — Conspiracy of One
A client who murdered his wife accuses counselor Tibbs of encouraging a police investigation, prompting Tibbs' resignation from his firm.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E18 — The Rabbi
Gillespie confronts Sparta's racist past after a synagogue is vandalized; guests Jerry Stiller; Mindy Rickles.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E19 — Hard Choices
Harriet DeLong's son Eugene witnesses a robbery in which a store owner is wounded, and his friend is involved.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E20 — Time's Long Shadow
The discovery of slave artifacts at a construction site leads to an archaeological survey and murder.

title: One in the Chamber
description: An experienced assassin works for both sides of a Russian gang war and becomes the target of a hidden enemy.

title: Snitch
description: To save his teenage son from an unjust prison sentence, a businessman (Dwayne Johnson) makes a deal with a U.S. attorney (Susan Sarandon) to infiltrate a dangerous drug cartel and become an informant.

title: Murder at 1600
description: A homicide detective and a Secret Service agent investigate the murder of a White House secretary who is found dead in a bathroom during an international crisis.

title: Sugar Mommas
description: Sisters Sheila and Lynn have loved sweets their entire life, so when they decided to start a business it came naturally to own a bakery. The sisters asked close friend Tommi to join them as their specialty pie maker.

title: Between Sisters
description: A bride and her sister set out to find their newly discovered siblings in order to invite them to the wedding.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S01 E01 — Pilot
A struggling comic (Wanda Sykes) lands a job as an on-air news reporter at a TV station in Washington, D.C.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S01 E02 — King Rat
Wanda must choose between a news story on health-code violations and her relationship with the Board of Health's vice president.

title: All About the Andersons
description:
S01 E13 — Home Movie
Anthony and his parents go to extremes producing a home movie to teach Tuga the true meaning of family.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E05 — Recreational Rodeo With Leslie Jones
Kevin Hart picks up Leslie Jones and heads to Gibson Ranch for a rodeo workout consisting of bathing a horse and roping a mechanical bull.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E06 — As Seen On TV Fitness With Bill Hader
Kevin Hart orders various fitness equipment from As Seen On TV and invites Bill Hader to try out the equipment.

title: A Thin Line Between Love and Hate
description: A wealthy woman stalks the womanizing club owner who seduced, then betrayed, her.

title: Eve's Bayou
description: Tragedy strikes a prosperous Louisiana family in 1962 after a girl (Jurnee Smollett) catches her father (Samuel L. Jackson) with another woman.

title: A Time to Kill
description: A Southern lawyer and his legal assistant defend a black man for killing his young daughter's white attackers.

title: Stealth Fighter
description: A fighter pilot (Ice-T) teams with an arms dealer to steal a bomber and blackmail the U.S. government.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E21 — Poor Relations
Against Gillespie's warnings, Parker's rowdy stepfather (Pat Hingle) returns to Sparta followed by homicidal art thieves; guest Anne Meara.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E22 — Dangerous Engagement
Harriet and Bill become targets of a crazed gunman on the eve of their wedding; guest William Gannon.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S07 E23 — Give Me Your Life
As Bill and Harriet prepare for their honeymoon, a cult leader's (Peter Fonda) activities get the attention of Forbes.

title: War
description: A federal agent (Jason Statham) seeks revenge on an elusive assassin (Jet Li) after his partner and family are killed, but the target ignites a war between rival Asian mobsters.

title: Armed Response
description: Trained operatives find themselves trapped inside an isolated military compound after its artificial intelligence is suddenly shut down. There, they begin to experience strange and horrific phenomena.

title: The Love Letter
description: An advice columnist (Keshia Knight Pulliam) uncovers her true feelings after writing an anonymous letter to herself.

title: Mr. Right
description: A writer (Erica Tazel) who has sworn off trying to find love is unexpectedly swept off her feet by a seemingly perfect man (Columbus Short). Things get complicated when she learns he works for a dating service.

title: Should've Put a Ring on It

title: Rock and Roll Revue
description: Vintage clips of great jazz artists.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S01 E03 — Wanda and Bradley
Roger tricks Wanda and Bradley into attending a basketball game where they'll have to sit near each other.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S01 E04 — Wanda's Party
Jenny, Barris and Holly make plans to throw Wanda a surprise party, even though Keith warns them not to.

title: All About the Andersons
description:

Anthony reconnects with a childhood friend, Marcus, but Joe thinks he is a bad influence on Anthony and Tuga.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:

Kevin Hart meets YouTube stars Rhett & Link at Hart's star on Hollywood Blvd; the trio then join a Strongman Competition.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:

Kevin Hart and Joel McHale meet heavyweight boxing champion Evander Holyfield for boxing 101.

description: A group of women (Kimberly Elise, Janet Jackson, Loretta Devine) comes together in search of commonality and understanding in the wake of personal crises, heartbreak and crimes.

description: In Detroit, a cunning serial killer (Matthew Fox) pushes young detective and psychologist Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) to his moral and psychological limits.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S08 E02 — A Matter of Justice
The trail of a serial killer leads the sheriff and police chief to a prominent citizen in Sparta, Miss.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:

Only the sheriff knows the identity of an actress returned home to Sparta, Miss.

title: The Substitute
description: A soldier of fortune (Tom Berenger) fills in for an injured teacher (Diane Venora) in a high school where gangs rule and the principal (Ernie Hudson) has a piece of the action.

title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
description: To avenge his brother's death, a mercenary works undercover as a teacher at a tough high school.

description: Nelson Mandela (Idris Elba) serves 27 years in prison, is instrumental in the abolishment of apartheid and eventually becomes South Africa's president.

title: Straight Outta Oakland 2
description: A desperate man begins selling drugs to pay for his aunt's cancer treatment.

title: South Central
description: Armed with moral reason and a father's love, an ex-convict (Glenn Plummer) lifts his son out of a dead-end Los Angeles gang.

title: Kevin Hart: What the Fit
description:
S01 E09 — Gymnastics With Terry Crews
Kevin Hart and workout enthusiast Terry Crews visit Gymnastics Olympic USA for an introduction to gymnastics.

title: The World, the Flesh and the Devil
description: A man (Harry Belafonte), a woman (Inger Stevens) and a bigot (Mel Ferrer) roam the city of New York, deserted after a nuclear war.

title: Sounder
description: A sharecropper's wife keeps the family together after he goes to prison in the 1930s Louisiana.

description: Filmmaker Charlotte Zwerin profiles the jazz pianist with interviews and with footage mostly from the 1967-68 period.

Gillespie's enemies try to run a smear campaign against him while his opponent's employee becomes a murder suspect.

description:
Grow Old Along With Me (1 & 2)
Gillespie and Forbes link a suspect to a witness of a hit-and-run fatality.
